WorkspaceView.description:
Used to send workspace state across the wire. The `Workspace`'s other fields (like
`LocalRepository`) would bloat the response and leak internal state.

CommitEntry.description:
Represents a file or directory entry at a specific commit.

`Hash` and `Eq` are based on the content hash field, so `HashSet<CommitEntry>`
deduplicates by file content. This is used during fetch and push to avoid
transferring the same content twice.

FileUploadBody.description: Multipart form for uploading files. Use `file` for a single full-path upload, or `files[]` for uploading one or more files into a directory.

example.message: Adding a picture of a cow
example.name: bessie

message.example: Adding a new image to the training set

FileUploadBody.title: FileUploadBody

RepoNew.description: Only used between client and server for creating a new remote repository.

name.description:
The name of the repository. When cloned locally, this is the name of the directory.
This name uniquely identifies it in the namespace.

namespace.description:
The namespace that the repository lives in: dictates application-level repository ownership.
A namespace can be e.g. a user, a team, or an entire organization. Namespaces must be unique.

oneOf.description: Which storage backend the server should use for this repo (e.g. "local", "s3").

StorageKind.description: Storage backend kind. Serializes as `"local"` / `"s3"` on the wire and on disk.

MetadataEntry.description:
`deny_unknown_fields` is the discriminator for the untagged `EMetadataEntry` enum:
payloads with a `changes` field (i.e. `WorkspaceMetadataEntry`) fail to deserialize here
and fall through to the workspace variant.

NewCommitBody.description: NewCommitBody is used to parse the json into a Commit from the API

ParsedResourceView.description: External (view) model that is returned to the client with fewer fields.
